ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alicon Castalloy Limited announced the resignation of Independent Director Mr. Ajay Patil, effective August 13, 2026, citing increased personal and professional commitments hindering his ability to devote sufficient time to board governance and oversight. A minor red flag is the company's nearly one-month delay in submitting the official resignation letter to the exchange, attributing it to an "inadvertent omission" in their initial regulatory filing, which suggests potential weaknesses in internal controls for complete and timely disclosures.
